g.text: Proportion of times a 95% confidence interval contains the true mean
Y axis truncated to only start at 80%; some points excluded because of that.
Points represent average from 10,000 simulations of given sample size. Shaded area shows 95% and higher, as desired.
Increasing sample size and growing effectiveness of the central limit theorem - confidence interval coverage
